messages:
ada-ux: Quick design huddle  proposing we standardize the left-nav lexicon and IA: use 'Projects' for workspaces, group by task clusters (Deployments, Models, Billing, Settings), and ensure deep-link behavior remains intact. Putting up a lightweight prototype tonight.
rick-fe: Agree on clusters. Implementation constraints: keep nav collapse visual-only (no history mutation). Router should use panel query param, e.g. /app/:org/projects/:id?panel=overview&anchor=widget-3. That keeps back-button predictable.
sana-a11y: A11y checklist: when opening a deep link, focus must move to the panel heading and we should announce "Opened: <Panel>" via aria-live. If there's a fragment target, scroll to it before announcing. Skip links order: Skip to Main Content, Skip to Projects, Skip to Search. Breadcrumbs should use aria-current and 48px tap targets.
leo-prod: Product asks legacy links keep working. We'll add a small redirect map from /workspace/:id/* -> /projects/:id?panel=... Also microcopy: nav label 'Projects' and toast on copy-link: "Link copied  opens Metrics at line 42".
rick-fe: Found previous bug where collapse toggles used replaceState for analytics which clobbered history and broke the back button. I'll remove history writes for UI-only actions and route panel changes with pushState. Also will defer auto-opening tips when arriving via deep link to avoid focus steals.
sana-a11y: Confirming: fragment-first behavior: detect anchor -> scroll -> set focus -> announce. Also ensure collapsed nav doesn't change tab order (visual-only).
ada-ux: (typo correction) I'll update prototype to show chevron breadcrumbs: "Projects > ProjectName > Metrics" (no trailing slash). Will include compact breadcrumb variant when nav is collapsed.
ci-bot: e2e: nav-ia-branch build #920 passed :white_check_mark:
rick-fe: I'll open PR with router changes, the redirect middleware, and the fragment->focus flow. Ping for a11y review.
ada-ux: Great, locking on task-cluster IA, 'Projects' label, panel query param routing, and fragment-first announce flow. Thanks everyone :pray:
